problem: External plugin authors need a neutral Catalog-to-ACAP interoperability proof.
existingInsufficient: The Phase1 baseline has no governed Catalog contract to consume.
abstraction: Bounded text round-trip independent of provider implementation.
alternatives: Arithmetic is possible but introduces unnecessary numerical semantics.
security: Bounded text, no persistence, no authority grants; runtime policy remains external.
scopes: Application and session vocabulary only; no self-granted scope.
compatibility: Preserve accepted input and promised output; review semantic changes.
genericRationale: Echo names no product, runtime, plugin or provider in its definition.
